title: GP-ITS (Cho 2026) -- D.C. Heller replication and cross-validation against gpss
paper: Cho, S. (2026), 'Let Time Tell: Identification and Gaussian Process Estimation for Interrupted Time Series', arXiv:2608.20610v1
reference_impl: gpss::gp_its (doeun-kim/gpss, GPL-3, CRAN) run live in R 4.3.3; replication scripts soonhong-cho/gpits (MIT)
verdict: build -- headline reproduces exactly; port matches gpss to ~1e-11

path_a_target.quantity: D.C. cumulative 4-month effect, background checks per 100k

simulation.note: paper uses 500 reps and n_pre 12..120 by 12; reduced here for runtime. C-ARIMA and CausalImpact arms omitted -- their R packages need CRAN, unreachable from this environment.
